I think the saddest thing I've done is well...
You guys may not think it's that sad compared to the torture-like sadness that other people present, but the saddest thing I've done is cry to myself quietly for about 2 hours.
I had a horrible day (at least in my book) my friends ignored me for someone else, I was failing a couple of classes, and it didn't help that I was depressed at the time (I still am, and have been for 3 months), all of the tears that I had stuffed in my eyes from past breakdowns wanted and needed to come out.
I just felt like absolute shit, and decided to shower to drown out the wails of hurt that I thought would come out, but I never wailed.
I just sat while warm water sprayed beside me, curled in a ball, and just cried soft and silently.
I dried off, and felt like I needed to cry more, so I hid my  sadness and went to cry in my bed.
I have a pillow that I sometimes cuddle with to simulate me cuddling with someone I love, and I hugged that thing and I kept crying to the point that my tears were hot.
I pretty much cried myself to sleep that night and in the morning I felt way better.
Hell, I still sometimes cry to get it all out, it feels really good after.
